title: Singleton coefficient of an affine family
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $c\in\mathbb R$, and $a=(a_i)_{i=0}^{n-1}\in\mathbb R^n$. For each coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the affine coefficient family associated to $c$ and $a$ has coefficient $a_i$ at the singleton set $\{i\}$.
replaced: Let $n\ge0$. Let $c\in\mathbb R$, $a\in\mathbb R^n$, and let $A_{c,a}(S)$ equal $c$ for $S=\varnothing$, $a_i$ for $S=\{i\}$, and zero for all larger $S$. For every $i\in[n]$, $A_{c,a}(\{i\})=a_i$.
